handles_reason: 0.5s starting pose + 0.5s ending/settled pose; loop seam, attack idle return, or death hold
loop_policy: Budget one complete original cycle. New shorter loops are an optional redesign, not a requirement of the engine.
one_shot_policy: Generate source duration plus handles subject to model minimum; retime/extract to gameplay timing later
long_clip_policy: H3 splits over-14s useful loops equally; each part gets its own handles. Stitching success is unproven.
excluded_dynamic_operations: Regent sword orbit, target-directed movement, Forge resizing, weapon counts
Osty independent HP, spawn, death/revive state, layout
Shader or particle-driven flame, poison, target effects
Unsupported player block/victory/revive or rest smith/sleep one-shots
